title: Journey To Destiny
description:
• You are a member selected by your secret organization to go on a mission. Transferred to your new HQ, with or without your partner, you'll find documents in your base that will help you identify where the energy stones are hidden. But beware, trials await you there. Can you overcome them?

• To complete your mission, you'll need to consult documents that will enable you to set up your teleporter at the various locations you'll be visiting. You'll travel back in time, analyzing the obstacles along the way, solving riddles and discovering the stories behind them. At the end of the journey, and with your mission successfully completed, you'll bring back the object so coveted by your secret organization: the Energy Stone. Will you succeed in your mission?

• Journey To Destiny has two modes: Solo and COOP. When you enter HQ, a computer will provide you with detailed documents, travel information and the parameters you need to set on the monitor connected to the teleporter. This will enable you to reach the chosen location, solve puzzles to progress through the game and find the energy stone that will be the final goal before returning to base.

Notes:
• Go alone or with your partner..

• Choose the adventure you want to experience..

• Communication and analysis are the two key words to progress during your journey..

Updates:
• Updates are planned for the future with new maps and chapters!

Enjoy your adventure.
description_short: You are sent on a mission, alone or in teams, by a secret organization. You'll have to travel using the documents available at your HQ to collect energy stones. But beware, a number of challenges await you. Can you overcome them?
